subject: Frostlane: Security architecture evidence handoff — availability and slots
messages:
From: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@frostlane.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@frostlane.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security evidence handoff + architecture deep-dive — scheduling

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Frostlane's security team reviewed the high-level materials and wants to schedule a technical deep-dive focused on SOC 2 evidence collection, encryption at-rest/in-transit, audit log retention, and SSO integration. They'd like the call to include architecture diagrams and a quick run-through of how Redwood surfaces audit logs and KMS integration.

Our initial ask: can we get a 60–75 minute session with your solutions architect and a short list of what artifacts we'll need to prepare ahead of time (e.g., service diagrams, sample audit exports, encryption whitepaper)?

Availability window: we prefer the week of July 17–21 (PDT), mornings are best for our east-coast reviewers. If you have multiple possible slots, we can confirm quickly. Also — we have a short SOC 2 evidence inventory (spreadsheet) that we'll upload if that helps.

Attaching a preliminary evidence inventory for your review.

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_inventory.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Elena Vargas
Security Program Manager
Frostlane Health
From: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@frostlane.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security evidence handoff + architecture deep-dive — scheduling

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask and the inventory. Marissa (Solutions Architect) and Aditya (Customer Success lead) will join. We can cover: evidence mapping to Redwood artifacts, how audit logs are exposed and retained, KMS/HSM options, and our SSO SAML/OIDC flow.

Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Mon 17 Jul 09:00–10:15
- Tue 18 Jul 10:30–11:45
- Wed 19 Jul 08:30–09:45

If none of those work, propose two alternatives and we’ll adjust. Please also let us know which team members from Frostlane will attend (engineering, security ops, compliance). I’ve attached the latest Redwood architecture diagram to orient the discussion.

Attachments: redwood-arch-diagram-v2.pdf (PDF)

—
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
From: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@frostlane.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@frostlane.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security evidence handoff + architecture deep-dive — scheduling

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the options. Quick note: several of our reviewers are in EST and the morning PDT slots are tight. Can we lock Tue 18 Jul 13:30–14:45 EDT (which is 10:30–11:45 PDT) — that matches your second option so looks good.

Attendees on our side: me (security PM), Marcus Holt (Head of Compliance, marcus.holt@frostlane.com), and two security engineers (security@frostlane.com). We'll also upload a sanitized export of our expected audit retention windows before the meeting.

One request ahead of time: could Marissa outline what specific log formats/redwood fields we should map to our retention policy? A short pre-read (one page) would be very helpful.

I'll accept the calendar invite once you send it.

Best,
Elena

Date: Thu, 13 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Architecture & SOC 2 evidence deep-dive — Tue 18 Jul 10:30–11:45 PDT

Elena / Marcus —

Thanks — calendar invite just sent for Tue 18 Jul, 10:30–11:45 PDT (13:30–14:45 EDT).

Pre-reads we will circulate by EOD Monday:
- 1-page log mapping doc (Marissa) — highlights: fields, sample JSON export, retention tags
- Redwood audit export example (anonymized)
- Short overview: KMS options and how envelope encryption is used for model artifacts

Action items:
- Frostlane: upload sanitized audit retention table to the shared Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_frostlane-evidence) before the call.
- Redwood: Marissa to produce 1-page log mapping and share the slide in the invite.

We’ll plan the session as 60 minutes for deep-dive + 15 minutes for Q&A. If you want follow-up sessions scoped (e.g., artifacts handoff for SOC 2 auditor), we can schedule those separately after the call.

Meeting invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=frostlane-redwood-arch-20280718

—
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
